concepts.why: The high-sensitivity troponin I level of 6327 pg/mL explains the uncovered fact of myocardial injury.
The combination of elevated troponin, negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR test results, and vascular imaging findings explains the uncovered facts of systemic inflammation and vascular damage.
